According to a 2000 ruling, it is unconstitutional for California to require Congressional candidates to reside in the district in which they run (http://articles.latimes.com/2000/jun/22/news/mn-43749). Hence the proposed edit to this sentence.

Not a member of Congressional Progressive Caucus, so calling her a progressive Democrat is misleading. Cited article only said that she was more liberal than her Republican opponent, saying nothing about where she stands relative to other Democrats.
